You know how you want it to feel. It’s the thousand choices that stall you.

Paint, tile, lighting, layout. Every decision feels permanent, so the room stays “almost done” and you stop inviting people over.

Kim takes the guessing off your plate. She learns how you live, narrows the choices, and makes the hard calls with you.

Hi, I’m Kim.

I’ve been a proud Hoosier all my life. Born in Elkhart, graduated from Butler, and I’ve made Fishers my home since 1995. My husband and I have five kids between us, plus one very adorable, mischievous dog named Bentley.

I spent years performing, including on the sidelines as a Colts cheerleader CONFIRM: OK to mention. A great performance can move you. I believe a room should too.

The best part of what I do is the final reveal, when all the planning, sourcing and dreaming come together into a story you’re proud to tell. My clients tend to become fast friends.

Kim Tokach

How it works

As much or as little help as you need.

Questions people ask

Do I have to redo the whole house?

No. Plenty of clients start with one room or one color consult. Kim helps as much or as little as you need.

Will my home end up looking like Kim’s style?

No. Kim’s goal is to understand your style and personality first, so the finished room tells your story.

What does it cost?

Consults are $150 for an hour, color consults $175, design and sourcing $150 an hour. Remodel designs are quoted after the first hour. CONFIRM
